roles.name: Security engineer
roles.focus: Credentials, secrets and data exposure: what an attacker can reach that they could not before, what gets logged or stored that should not, and what happens when a token leaks.

roles.name: Design
roles.focus: What a person actually experiences: whether the first run makes sense without explanation, what the error states look like, and what the interface implies that is not true.

roles.name: SRE
roles.focus: What happens at 3am: how this fails, whether the failure is visible, what it costs to roll back, and what a stuck or half-finished run leaves behind.

brief: This ships to every user on day one and touches stored credentials, so blast radius matters more than elegance.
